agent_events_paypal_check.name: agent_events_paypal_check
agent_events_paypal_check.value: "agent_events"."paypal_id" is null or "agent_events"."paypal_api" is not null

handoffs_pay_check.name: handoffs_pay_check
handoffs_pay_check.value: ("handoffs"."decision" is null) = ("handoffs"."pay_cents" is null) and ("handoffs"."pay_cents" is null or "handoffs"."pay_cents" >= 0)

listing_drafts_details_check.name: listing_drafts_details_check
listing_drafts_details_check.value: "listing_drafts"."status" not in ('ready', 'listed') or "listing_drafts"."details" is not null

listings_same_room_check.name: listings_same_room_check
listings_same_room_check.value: "listings"."handoff_mode" <> 'same_room' or ("listings"."room_preset_id" is not null and "listings"."room_number" is not null)

orders_reauthorization_check.name: orders_reauthorization_check
orders_reauthorization_check.value: "orders"."reauthorized_at" is null or ("orders"."payment_mode" = 'authorize_then_capture' and "orders"."paypal_authorization_id" is not null)

plans_move_in_check.name: plans_move_in_check
plans_move_in_check.value: ("plans"."move_in_starts_at" is null) = ("plans"."move_in_ends_at" is null) and ("plans"."move_in_starts_at" is null or "plans"."move_in_ends_at" > "plans"."move_in_starts_at")

users_room_check.name: users_room_check
users_room_check.value: "users"."room_number" is null or "users"."room_preset_id" is not null
